title: Recursive CTE that cycles
statement:
Consider this query:

WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (
  SELECT 1
  UNION
  SELECT n % 3 + 1 FROM r
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r;

Which statements are true in SQLite? Pick every one that applies.
choices: It never finishes: n cycles through 1, 2, 3, 1, ... forever.
With UNION ALL instead of UNION (and nothing else changed), it never finishes.
It is rejected: the recursive part of a CTE needs a WHERE clause to stop.
